pull_request.title: Documentation: Reproducible ODD tracker IdRes comparison
pull_request.head: codex/odd-idres-comparison
pull_request.body:
Adds reproducible IdRes SVGs and complete plot data for original ODD and the existing extended tracker prototype before and after DES018 outer pixel disc aperture adaptation. The report records the exact geometry sources, expanded JSON inputs, pitch/√12 response, units, commands, versions and hashes so the figures can be recreated and new plots made without rerunning IdRes.

- Seven SVGs cover layouts, technology hit counts, material, inverse/relative pT uncertainty, vertex controls and pixel apertures. Full CSV/JSON tables and every raw `.geom`, `.res`, `.hits`, `.X0` and execution log are retained.
- 64,881 complete nominal fit rows cover signed eta −4…4, pT 1/10/100 GeV, vertices −150/0/+150 mm and separate 2/3/4 T processes. All 54 independent measurement-only covariance controls pass at printed precision; all independent hit/material comparisons agree.
- The adapted aperture preserves every sampled extended hit/profile/fit. Forward inverse-pT uncertainty improves versus the original layer model, while the high-pT far-forward relative-error linearization remains invalid; the report retains that limitation.

Material uses the explicitly labelled common DES006 layer allowances (pixel 1%, short strip 1.5%, long-strip pair 2% X0), not a full DD4hep material scan. The original ODD and current tracker are ideal layer reductions with common current prototype response. No production detector, accepted evidence or design state changes. IdRes source access/licence remains an external dependency; upstream source is not vendored.

Validation: 8 new study tests, 3 existing covariance tests and 4 existing IdRes adapter tests pass. Retained-artifact verification checks all samples, raw/source/producer hashes, CSV/JSON equality and SVG parsing. Expanded geometry JSON and all seven SVGs regenerate byte-for-byte in the recorded environment. Figures visually inspected. Project records, session logs, token-site validation and `git diff --check` pass. CI adds offline verification without requiring IdRes access.

Report and entry point: `docs/validation/ODD-idres/README.md`. Related: DES006/013/018–023 and TASK-PUB-ODD-IDRES.

Token accounting (2026-10-20): the original PR work now records **12,783,549 input + 53,939 output = 12,837,488 observed tokens** across three disjoint closed turns (67 observed requests). Cached input 12,530,816 and reasoning output 15,583 are subsets. Exact counters, boundary/event digests, ownership and exclusions are retained in `logs/usage/USAGE-2026-10-20-pr89-accounting.json` and the original IdRes session. Import replay adds nothing. The active accounting/readiness follow-up is excluded until its final counters are available; no cost or model identity is inferred.

events.text:
- Seven SVGs and their plotting manifests; complete expanded geometry JSON and
  source extraction/hash map; all raw geom/res/hits/X0/log outputs retained.
- 9 nominal IdRes runs cover signed eta -4..4 step0.01, pT1/10/100GeV,
  vertices -150/0/+150mm and separate2/3/4T processes:64881 finite fit rows.
- 7209 independent technology hit/material profiles; every raw hit count and
  origin material sum agrees with the independent calculation at printed precision.
- 54 near-zero-material controls agree with independent SVD curvature covariance
  within half the printed1e-6GeV^-1 unit using the same0.3 conversion convention.
- Short strips are classified as pixel-like by IdRes because their coarse sigma
  is144um. Technology plots therefore use JSON metadata, preserving all raw counts.
- The DES018 aperture reduction leaves every sampled extended hit-ID list,
  material profile and resolution unchanged. At eta4/origin/100GeV/3T,
  sigma(1/pT) improves223.919->22.959TeV^-1 from original to extended, but the
  latter still gives pT*sigma(1/pT)>1. This is not a Gaussian relative-pT resolution.
- Material is only the explicit1/1.5/2%X0 per-layer fixture. No beam pipe,
  distributed services, detailed passive supports, reconstruction or finite-module
  transport result is claimed. Existing design states and accepted evidence stay unchanged.

events.text:
All 64,881 IdRes fit rows completed, and the 54 near-zero-material controls agree with the independent covariance calculation at IdRes’s printed precision.

The aperture variant preserves the extended layout’s hits and resolution across the sampled |η| ≤ 4 grid. The extension improves forward curvature information, but at 100 GeV the η ≈ 4 uncertainty is still too large to interpret as a Gaussian fractional momentum resolution. I’m making that limit explicit in the plots and documentation.
